scope: 1.6 m above current valid display surface human-eye camera and path-safe near-ground navigation
sourceData: R3.1 locked DEM/coast/river files are referenced in place; no measurement bytes are modified or duplicated

cameraContract.farClipKm: 5 to 60 depending on current patch extent
cameraContract.groundRelation: current valid display triangle surface only
cameraContract.movement: WASD/wheel/buttons and tool movement validate the full requested path in 0.5-2 m substeps; movement stops before missing support or clipped-marine display

precisionClaim: none beyond inherited source; 1.6 m is a camera/display relationship, not terrain accuracy

fullPackagePlan.method: download verified R3.1 full release, verify base SHA and base MANIFEST, overlay R3.2, regenerate complete MANIFEST, verify again, publish new R3.2 full release

fullWorld3AConstraint: 12.5 m DEM with ~30 m source information scale cannot by itself establish meter-scale roads, rocks, buildings, vegetation or riverbed truth; those require independent sourced object/environment layers
